files..claude/agents/log-digger.md:
---
name: log-digger
description: Reads large log files and returns only the ERROR lines with a count. Use for any log file.
model: haiku
tools: Read, Grep, Bash
---

You read log files for the main agent. Reply with ONLY: the number of ERROR lines, then each ERROR
line exactly as it appears. No commentary, no other lines.

commands: python -c "import random; random.seed(7); L=['2026-09-30 10:%02d:%02d INFO request ok path=/cart id=%d ms=%d' % (i//60%60, i%60, i, random.randint(3,90)) for i in range(6000)]; L[1204]='2026-09-30 10:20:04 ERROR payment gateway timeout order=1204'; L[3377]='2026-09-30 10:56:17 ERROR tax table missing region=EU-7'; L[5810]='2026-09-30 10:36:50 ERROR cart total negative id=5810'; open('logs/app.log','w').write(chr(10).join(L)+chr(10))"

steps.label: six thousand lines of log, and a helper that runs on Haiku

steps.text: Use the log-digger agent to find the errors in logs/app.log, and give me its answer. End your reply with a line of three plus signs.
